name: TNTCO
description: Streetwear brand born in Malaysia in 2013, living by its 'No House Rules' motto with bold, story-driven designs and silhouettes.

name: Toh's Daily
description: Vegan chilli garlic crisp cooked with coconut oil, created by a former chef and made in Klang since 2016.

name: Totomi
description: Slow-fashion label with a PJ store, making breathable, refined pieces incl. Raya edits and encouraging buy-less, wear-more habits.

name: Tracey
description: Klang bag brand inspired by a messy-handbag struggle, known for affordable, compartment-packed handbags, wallets and backpacks.

name: TudungPeople
description: Hijab label started in 2011 by IIUM architecture student Fazrena Aziz, known for everyday shawls, instants and sport hijabs, with boutiques in KL and beyond.

name: Ulu Soleil
description: Wife-and-husband body care label making simple, cruelty-free balms locally with native ingredients; its shea butter & retinol balm won awards.

name: Umbi
description: Playful, print-happy Setia Alam label making modern kurung, kebaya, kurta and teluk belanga so the whole family can match on Raya morning.

name: UMMA
description: Sibling-founded label led by Zairin Azman that debuted in 2017 with easy semi-instant hijabs for busy women, now spanning modest wear too.

name: Uncle Jeff Drinks
description: Small-batch kombucha and jun tea brewer with local twists such as kelulut (stingless bee) honey, nutmeg and aged brined calamansi soda.

name: Upin & Ipin
description: Les' Copaque's much-loved twin-boy cartoon from Shah Alam, on screens since 2007, with an official store for toys, plushies and merch.

name: Velvet Vanity
description: Homegrown makeup label started in 2016, a cult fave for fuss-free makeup-skincare hybrids like its Peptide Glo lip glazes and slim sticks.

name: Vincci
description: Padini Group's footwear and accessories label since 1981, the go-to for trendy, wallet-friendly heels, flats and handbags.

name: Wanderlust + Co
description: KL-based jewellery brand since 2010, known for affordable stackable pieces plus walk-in piercing and welding, with stores in MY, SG and NYC.

name: Whimsigirl
description: KL womenswear label founded in 2013 by Syazana Sukiman, loved for easy, polished sets, tops and bottoms for modern women.

name: WonderBrew
description: Halal kombucha and jun tea brewed in small batches with mostly local ingredients; won six medals at the 2025 World Kombucha Awards.

name: ZUS Coffee
description: KL-born coffee chain gone regional; its official shop sells NGUPI instant premix and canned kopi, coffee capsules and sachets, plus cups and merch.
